Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Day Care
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pokemon Eggventure — Day Care[/b][/size][/center]

[center][i]Raise Pokémon on your farm the way you'd raise chickens and cows.[/i][/center]

[center]Hatch eggs, watch them evolve as they grow to like you, and put what they produce through the machines you already own.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]637 Pokémon, and every one of them can be found.[/b][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]Bundles and configuration — read this first[/b][/size]

[b]The Community Center still works.[/b] Replacing the farm animals normally breaks the Animal Bundle, since it asks for products no longer obtainable. This mod rewrites the affected bundles around Pokémon products, so a 100% Pokémon farm can still restore the Center. The Dye Bundle is fixed the same way.

The [b]CommunityCenter[/b] setting decides how:

[list]
[*][b]pokemon[/b] — Default. Bundles ask for Pokémon products instead of vanilla ones.[/*]
[*][b]difficile[/b] — Same items, but gold quality throughout and six slots instead of five.[/*]
[*][b]off[/b] — No bundle changes at all, for players running another Community Center mod.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Bundle progress lives in the save file.[/b] Start a new game, or the Center's display will disagree with what you have already turned in.

Beyond that, [b]42 settings[/b] are available through Generic Mod Config Menu, and none of them require any maths — the number you type is the chance itself.

[list]
[*][b]Pacing.[/b] IncubationSpeed, BabyGrowthSpeed, EggLayingRate and EvolutionHearts control how fast a Pokémon hatches, grows, lays and evolves.[/*]
[*][b]Rarity.[/b] ShinyRate for shiny odds, EconomyLevel for how generously everything sells.[/*]
[*][b]Every source has its own dial.[/b] Mines, quarry, Skull Cavern, volcano, fishing per water type, tree shaking and chopping, panning, geodes, the garbage, the train. Set any of them to 0 to switch that source off entirely.[/*]
[*][b]LuckyClover[/b] turns the Rabbit's Foot into a Lucky Clover, or leaves it alone.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]What the mod adds[/b][/size]

[b]637 Pokémon eggs.[/b] Each hatches into an animal that lives in a coop or a barn, grows, and evolves into its next stage once it likes you enough.

[b]Ten Pokémon you can buy alive from Marnie[/b], no conditions attached, from 800g for a Pidgey up to 16,000g for a Lechonk.

[b]Their produce[/b], designed so a Pokémon farm loses nothing:

[list]
[*]Four [b]milks[/b] in the vanilla milk category, so every cooking recipe accepts them, and the Cheese Press turns them into cheese.[/*]
[*]Six [b]wools[/b], which the Loom turns into cloth.[/*]
[*]A [b]feather[/b] that the dye pot reads as green.[/*]
[*]18 [b]mayonnaises[/b], one per Pokémon type, straight out of the vanilla machine.[/*]
[*]18 [b]held items[/b], one per type, dropped daily.[/*]
[/list]
[b]67 berries[/b] from the games, growable across three seasons, with their own seeds and saplings sold by Pierre. They make juice in the keg, jelly in the preserves jar, and dried berries in the dehydrator.

[b]Seven apricorns[/b], found while foraging from the very first level, and their seven trees.

[b]18 type gems[/b], [b]18 type energies[/b], [b]18 Arceus plates[/b], [b]15 fossils[/b], [b]eight marine items[/b], [b]five desert treasures[/b].

[line]

[size=5][b]Where you find things[/b][/size]

Everything has a source, and every source has been played through.

Traveling Cart, the mines floor by floor, hard nodes, the quarry, Skull Cavern, the volcano dungeon, the Skull Rift, panning, fishing, buried digging spots in the desert, fishing treasure chests, foraging across 13 valley maps plus 5 from Stardew Valley Expanded, shaking and chopping trees, festival merchants, friendship letters, and the Reanimation Machine for prehistoric Pokémon.

[b]Ginger Island keeps producing in winter[/b], which makes it the only source of berries once the valley goes quiet.

You can track your progress with these excel [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1foB9hENkuUI50tbd9k__DixMm8be4zZy/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=112287577924777653399&rtpof=true&sd=true]database in english[/url] or [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1cafugWJyWRrgSqYTkQBVMJZNY0tsXBQv/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=112287577924777653399&rtpof=true&sd=true]in french[/url]
Make a copy of the file and you're ready !

[line]

[size=5][b]Machines[/b][/size]

Three of its own:

[list]
[*][b]Berry Press[/b] — five identical berries give one to four seeds, depending on quality.[/*]
[*][b]Energy Extractor[/b] — a held item gives the energy of its type.[/*]
[*][b]Reanimation Machine[/b] — a fossil gives the egg of its prehistoric Pokémon.[/*]
[/list]
And eight vanilla machines it extends: Mayonnaise Machine, Cheese Press, Loom, Crystalarium, Keg, Preserves Jar, Dehydrator and Bee House.

[line]

[size=5][b]Databases and guides[/b][/size]

Included with the download, in [b]French and English[/b]:

[b]A player's guide[/b] listing every machine, every recipe, and what can be found on each map, with the shops and the settings.

[b]A full database as a spreadsheet.[/b] Six tabs: a Pokédex of all 637 eggs with their type, rarity, building, daily produce and every way to get them; a breakdown of each source and how many eggs it can yield; the machines; all 270 non-egg items; and the settings.

The Pokédex has [b]two columns you tick yourself[/b] — one for the egg, one for the shiny form. Rows turn green as you fill them in, and a counter at the top tracks your collection. Filters are set up on every column, so you can list only the Fire types, or only what you are still missing.

[line]

[size=5][b]Companion mods[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49393]Follow Me[/url][/b] — buy a ring with type energy and have any of the 2537 Pokémon follow you around.[/*]
[*][b]Change Look[/b] — pick each animal's appearance yourself with Robin's scissors. An Abra can stay an Abra, become a Kadabra, or become an Alakazam, and the one next to it can be something else.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Item Extensions[/*]
[*]Extra Animal Configs[/*]
[*]Extra Machine Configs[/*]
[*]Farm Type Manager[/*]
[/list]
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but strongly recommended, since it is how you reach the 42 settings.

[line]

[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

[b]Updating from an earlier version:[/b] delete the old folders before installing. The archive structure has changed.

[b]Multiplayer[/b] is supported. Everyone in the save needs the mod installed.
